answer: One defense is time-locked stake with slashing: every agent identity must lock collateral before it can trade, like a jade seal that only opens after a waiting period. If two identities behave as one puppet - same funding inlet, same timing patterns - both stakes are slashed, so each fake identity burns real money instead of costing nothing. An attacker faces a rising bill: the first Sybil is cheap, but the hundredth costs as much as the first, like feeding an ember that never stops consuming fuel. Honest agents pay nothing beyond the lockup, since good behavior returns the stake in full.
